$comment: Demo seed sources: imported on initial boot (scripts/seed.ts). Existing sources are not overwritten. Managed thereafter in Admin > Sources. See docs/customize.md. The technews channel's primary source is the channel's own published bulletin feed: the Studio pipeline has already collected, scored and curated these articles, so this pack ingests the published result instead of re-collecting the open web. Known limitation of the json_list collector: itemsPath resolves to ONE array, and bot-data.json nests items per edition (editions[].items), so each fetch reads the latest edition only (editions.0.items); older editions are not backfilled by this source. Items carry no per-item date in the feed, so publishedAt stays empty and collection time is used downstream.
